mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates ultra-loose monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as the cost of capital declines.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending capacity, resulting in negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in RSAFS (personal consumption) and HOUST (housing starts) over the past 3 months indicates weakening aggregate demand, causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST decline simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production below 100.0 indicates weakening output momentum that triggers equity risk aversion, producing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 550.0 thousand units indicates robust residential construction demand that correlates with positive equity market sentiment, driving positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns through reduced valuation multiples.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals labor market overheating without output growth, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to inflationary pressure concerns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, a housing starts level below 500.0 thousand units indicates weak consumer confidence that reduces equity market participation, causing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is below 500.0 during post-recession recovery.
